title: 改变的第一步是接纳

timeline.summary: The speaker introduces people who complain that changing is too hard and tells them not to keep criticizing themselves.
He argues that repeated self-criticism lowers self-esteem and consumes energy that could otherwise support change.
He proposes first accepting the present self, including acknowledging having made mistakes or hurt others, while still loving oneself and believing one can do better.
He concludes that accepting one's problem is what makes change possible.
